title: Man Calls The Police and Ends Up Getting Fired
description:
An officer was dispatched to a fight in progress. He first made contact with a male in red, later identified as 33-year-old Dericc. The fight was between Derric and his employee, 25-year-old Randall. Both the parties give a completely different account of what really happened. Both parties were let go with a warning. Who do you think is at fault? Tell us in the comments.
